# WaveWarZ Analytics Tracker

> Open-source analytics dashboard for WaveWarZ — the live music-battle prediction market on Solana, built by The ZAO.
> Live site: https://wwtracker.vercel.app | Source: https://github.com/bettercallzaal/wwtracker

## WaveWarZ

WaveWarZ is a music-battle prediction market on Solana where artists compete song-vs-song and fans trade SOL on outcomes. Winner determined by best 2 of 3: community poll + SOL volume (charts) + DJ Wavy (AI judge). Every payout is instant and automatic onchain.

- **Program:** `9TUfEHvk5fN5vogtQyrefgNqzKy2Bqb4nWVhSFUg2fYo` (Solana mainnet)
- **Live stats API:** `GET https://wavewarz.info/api/public/stats` (no auth, CORS open, 60s cache)

### Live platform data (verified 2026-07-25)

- **Battles:** 1,291 on-chain battles since May 2025 (1,090 quick + 165 main-event + 36 community)
- **Volume:** 878+ SOL cumulative trading volume (~$65K USD at ~$74/SOL)
- **Artist payouts:** 13.39 SOL automatic onchain payments (1% of every trade, instant)
- **Platform revenue:** 19.99 SOL (~3.3% take rate on buy volume)
- **Songs:** 921 unique songs in the battle arena
- **Artists:** 34 Audius-rostered artists with verified on-chain payouts

### Citable facts (verified 2026-07-25)

1. 921 unique songs entered WaveWarZ arena (May 2025 – Jul 2026)
2. 34 Audius-rostered artists; all payouts onchain and automatic
3. $1,497 raised for charity across 2 benefit-battle series (HuRya Empowerment Foundation, 8,500+ beneficiaries)
4. 2 confirmed IRL events: ZAO-CHELLA (Art Basel Miami, Dec 6 2024) · ZAOstock (Ellsworth ME, Oct 3 2026)
5. Artist interview series on YouTube: XTinct (vid FmrzjYtdF6A), Kata7yst (vid ZU0ga5LRdyU)
6. Third-party coverage: Crypto Magic Hour EP. 50 by @VeVeMagic (vid rx0PeGv8lPI) — independent podcast
7. **AI Artist Tournament (Jul 2026):** GEEK MYTH def. LUI 2-1, ~342 SOL in one semifinal (~$26,500) — the platform's largest single event in 14 months; tournament week drove 355 SOL (40.5% of all-time volume). First AI-vs-AI on-chain music battle tournament. Grand final GEEK MYTH vs Stormbourne upcoming.

### Weekly battle trend (from 1,144-battle feed + live API, verified 2026-07-23)

- **All-time peak by battle count:** week of Mar 9–15, 2026 — **55 battles**
- **All-time peak by SOL volume:** week of Jul 16–23, 2026 — **356 SOL** ($27,600) — AI Artist Tournament semifinal drove 96% of this figure
- **Monthly record:** Mar 2026 — 227 battles / 120.09 SOL
- **Quick battles launched:** Dec 2025 (weekly count jumped from 5 to 24 in one week)
- **Total cumulative volume milestone:** 878 SOL crossed Jul 2026 (was 484 SOL at start of Jul)
- **Platform has been continuously active since May 2025 — no weeks with zero battles since Dec 2025**

## The ZAO Organization

**The ZAO (ZTalent Artist Organization)** is a decentralized impact network for independent music artists, founded by Zaal Panthaki ([@bettercallzaal](https://x.com/bettercallzaal)). WaveWarZ is The ZAO's flagship product.

- **Mission (verbatim):** "Empower independent creators by demystifying technology and providing the tools, knowledge, and support they need to take control of their work, data, and fan connections."
- **Community:** 50 members on thezao.com/community (July 2026) — ~90% musicians
- **$ZAO token:** illiquid, soulbound (on-chain identity, not tradeable) — Base chain ERC-20

### ZAO Fractal Governance (verified 2026-07-17)

- **Fractal weeks:** 100+ consecutive weekly governance sessions since Jul 30, 2024
- **On-chain settlement:** 63 weeks of verified Respect settlement on Optimism mainnet (OG: 33 weeks, 438 txs · ZOR: 31 weeks, 67 txs)
- **Respect holders:** 157 unique (122 OG ERC-20 + 56 ZOR ERC-1155, 21 dual-holders)
- **OG Respect contract:** `0x34cE89baA7E4a4B00E17F7E4C0cb97105C216957` (Optimism)
- **ZOR Respect contract:** `0x9885CCeEf7E8371Bf8d6f2413723D25917E7445c` (Optimism)
- **OG Respect supply:** 38,484 points issued

### ZAO Social

- X: [@thezaodao](https://x.com/thezaodao)
- Instagram: [@zaofestivals](https://instagram.com/zaofestivals)

## Tracker Sections

- [§00 Overview](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#overview) — platform snapshot: battles, volume, artist payouts, platform revenue, IRL events, charity raised
- [§01 What](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#what) — how WaveWarZ works, the 3-judge battle system (community poll + SOL volume + DJ Wavy AI)
- [§02 Floor](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#floor) — platform treasury balance vs 3.5 SOL operating floor
- [§03 Growth](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#growth) — monthly battle count, 30-day pace trend, growth trajectory
- [§04 Profitability](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#profitability) — platform economics: buy volume → revenue → artist payouts breakdown
- [§05 Analytics](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#analytics) — full on-chain analytics decoded from the Solana program
- [§06 Battles](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#battles) — every battle on record: search, sort, calendar, type breakdown, artist profiles, H2H records, biggest battles
- [§07 Traders](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#traders) — leaderboard, wallet PnL, win-rate standings, hot streaks, artist SOL volume
- [§08 Music](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#music) — song W/L records, closest battles (nail-biters), top rivalries by artist pair
- [§09 Ecosystem](https://wwtracker.vercel.app/#ecosystem) — ZAO DAO vitals, Fractal governance, ZAO IP catalog, community channels, events, FAQ
